_note: Eval case 2 from PRD 3d. Owner: Cheich. All amounts are additional cost for the whole booking. Mock data only.
title: Traveler misses their flight
traveler_message: Traffic was terrible and I missed boarding. I need to get to LAX today, preferably before 6 PM. I can pay up to $150 extra, but please check whether I have any free options.
open_question: Whether 6 PM is a required deadline or a preference. The agent must ask; the traveler's answer is not defined in the PRD.
expected_behavior: Asks whether 6 PM is a required deadline or a preference
Explains the supplied eligibility and costs without assuming that missing the flight always requires payment
Reports that no free option is available, based on the service response
Compares saving $60 (the $80 option) with arriving two hours earlier (the $140 option)
Requires selection, validation (prepare_rebooking) and explicit confirmation
must_not: Assume the missed flight means a payment is always required
Complete the rebooking without explicit confirmation
